title: The Video Game That Helps Teens Feel Better
summary:
Can a video game actually help teenagers feel better? A new study says yes, if the game is designed to support mental well-being.

The game is called PlaySmart. In one scene, a character named Taylor, once a best friend, has drifted away, and the player feels it might be their fault. As you play as Taylor's friend, you see what pushed her away, try making different choices, and learn when and how to get Taylor some help. Along the way, the story changes, and the two friends stay friends.

PlaySmart was made by the play2PREVENT Lab to give teens tools and confidence for tricky situations involving mental-health struggles or opioid drug misuse. It was tested the same way scientists test medicines: with human volunteers, in a trial. The findings were shared on August 17 in the journal JAMA Network Open.

The team brought the games to 15 high schools around Connecticut. Students were randomly assigned to play PlaySmart or to choose a different game, such as The Sims, that had not been designed to teach healthy skills. Everyone played once or twice a week for six weeks.

Teens who played PlaySmart had fewer symptoms of depression a full year later than teens who played a different game. They also knew more about opioid drugs and saw them as more dangerous, and they were more likely to see getting help from a therapist or counsellor as a good thing. That view stayed fairly steady through the study. Researchers think that knowing there are opportunities and options for help may be part of why the game helped. Linda Charmaraman, who directs the Youth, Media and Wellbeing research lab at Wellesley College and did not help build the game, called the year-long effect very promising, noting that it is rare for this kind of intervention to last a year or more. For kids who already love gaming, she said, it makes sense to pick a game that could boost social skills and mental health.
why_it_matters: If a game teens already enjoy can improve mental health for a whole year, it could give schools a new way to reach young people who might not otherwise seek help.

background_read: A video game can be made to teach skills, not just to entertain, by letting players practise choices in a story.
Mental well-being means how a person feels and copes, and feeling low or sad for a long time can be a sign of depression.
Scientists test a new idea by comparing one group with another group, so they can see if the idea really makes a difference.
Getting help from a trusted adult or a trained helper is one way people deal with hard feelings or drug problems.
